name: t3-tri-plan
description: T3 Code-native triple-blind Trellis planning pipeline: parallel read-only multi-model design (e.g. Gemini 4 Neon + Claude Opus 5.5 + GPT 6.2 Sol), zero-history anonymous blind judging with pre-reveal decision & initial-design freeze, council design-review convergence loop, transactional flock state machine, and safe Phase 6 activation.

interface.shortDescription: Triple-blind multi-model Trellis planning and design-review convergence pipeline for T3 Code.
interface.longDescription: Standalone T3 Code-native planning pipeline compatible with Trellis tasks without modifying repository dual-plan files. Runs 3 parallel read-only blind design candidates via delegate_task, evaluates them in a zero-history anonymous blind judge that locks the winner, surgical cherry-picks, and initial design before revealing model attribution, then runs a multi-model council/default design-review convergence loop with atomic flock transactions, cross-round baseline freshness checks, and process-locked Phase 6 activation.
defaultPrompt: Run t3-tri-plan on the current Trellis task.
